R=C=20
ones=[(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]
# rectangle r2..8 c9..15
G=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
for r in range(2,9):
    left=any(rr==r and cc<9 for rr,cc in ones)
    right=any(rr==r and cc>15 for rr,cc in ones)
    for c in range(9,16): G[r][c]=2
    if not left:
        for c in range(0,9): G[r][c]=2
    if not right:
        for c in range(16,20): G[r][c]=2
for c in range(9,16):
    above=any(cc==c and rr<2 for rr,cc in ones)
    below=any(cc==c and rr>8 for rr,cc in ones)
    if not above:
        for r in range(0,2): G[r][c]=2
    if not below:
        for r in range(9,20): G[r][c]=2
for r,c in ones: G[r][c]=1
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
